kjv: they (God's foes) have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land
mine: they (God's foes) burned all the meeting places of God in the land
note: mo'ade-'el are "meeting places/appointed places of God"; "synagogues" names a later institution and is an anachronism for the period of the temple's destruction.

kjv: thou (God) brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters
mine: you (God) broke the heads of the sea monsters on the waters
note: tanninim are the sea monsters of creation myth (paired with Leviathan in v.14); "dragons" conveys a land-based fire-breather.

kjv: [A man] was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees
mine: They (God's foes) were like those who swing axes in a forest of trees
note: yiwwada' "it was known/seemed" is obscure: the enemies looked like woodcutters; the KJV reads it as "a man was famous".
